title: OmniPod fault 049 INSULIN_DELIVERY_COMMAND_ERROR when temp basal is automatically set
body:
My pod suddenly started screaming and i got a 049 error. The phone was unused in my pocket at the time.

Looking as the logs, the error appears to happen when the app is trying to set a temporary basal in response to a new glucose reading. It begins at 2020-02-10 13:16:29 when a new glucose reading is received and results in a PodFaultException at 13:16:36.

I use an EmaLink. Glucose readings are received from a Libre 2 using the patched LibreLink app and XDrip.

AndroidAPS 2.8.2
Build: 194549adc-2021.01.23-19:55
Flavor: fullrelease
Nightscout version: 14.0.2

[aaps-pod-error-49-excerpt.log](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/files/5964313/aaps-pod-error-49-excerpt.log)
[aaps-logs.zip](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/files/5964315/aaps-logs.zip)
